name: pnp-spfx-copilot-apps-holiday-planner
title: Holiday Planner - Working Days, Long Weekends, and Regional Holidays in Copilot Chat
shortDescription: Five SPFx Copilot Components and one declarative agent that calculate working days, find long weekends with bridge-day suggestions, list holidays, check dates, and compare office calendars directly in Copilot chat.
longDescription: Holiday Planner is a SharePoint Copilot App built as five SPFx 1.24 Copilot Components under a single declarative agent. Each tool renders a live React card in the Copilot conversation: an inclusive working-day count, the next long weekend with the working days until it and any bridge-day suggestion, a full-year, month, or upcoming holiday list, a working-day check for a specific date or named holiday, and a side-by-side comparison of regional calendars.

Expanding a card opens a shared dashboard with calendar tabs, holiday details, and a Vacation Optimizer. Holiday data is read from a SharePoint list under the signed-in user's delegated identity, configured through a tenant storage entity, with demo data as a labelled fallback. The default country resolves from the query, a OneDrive-saved preference, the user's profile, or browser hints, and the pure planning calculations are unit tested.
